        Sqpi.h(range(num_spins))
        Sqpi.cx(range(num_spins), range(num_spins-1, -1, -1))
        Sqpi.h(range(num_spins))

            C2.cx(i, i+1)
        C2.cp(np.pi/4, num_spins-1, num_spins, 'z')
